meta.defaultTitle: AuraConvert — All the tools you need. In one place.
meta.defaultDescription: Use PDF, image, text, video, and developer tools in one consistent interface. AuraConvert is a browser-based online tools platform.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: Personalize your AuraConvert experience. Choose a theme that suits your style.

home.heroTitle: All the tools you need. In one place.
home.heroSubtitle: Run PDF, image, text, media, and developer tools in the browser, under one design system. New tools can be added without rewriting the platform.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search PDF, character counter, images, or speed test…
home.emptyCategory: No tools in this category yet.

toolsPage.title: All tools
toolsPage.subtitle: Browse registered tools by category. Adding a new tool only requires its own folder and a registry entry.
toolsPage.empty: No tools to show in this view.

tool.notFoundBody: There is no registered tool for this address.

text.name: Text
text.description: Character counting, encoding, and writing tools

utility.name: Utility
utility.description: Generate strong passwords and use handy mini-tools.

character-counter.name: Character Counter
character-counter.description: Count characters, words, and lines in real time.

image-compressor.name: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Reduce image file size directly in your browser without losing quality.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Resize and scale images by adjusting width and height instantly.

background-remover.name: Background Remover
background-remover.description: Remove image backgrounds in seconds using on-device AI.

image-converter.name: Image Converter
image-converter.description: Convert your images to JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF formats.

watermark-remover.name: Watermark Remover
watermark-remover.description: Remove unwanted text, logos, or objects from your images.

favicon-generator.name: Favicon Generator
favicon-generator.description: Convert your images into website favicons (ICO and PNG) compatible with all modern devices.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, and debug your JSON data right in your browser.

pdf-compressor.name: PDF Compressor
pdf-compressor.description: Reduce the file size of your PDFs. Processing is done securely in your browser without uploading to any server.

password-generator.name: Strong Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate secure, hard-to-crack random passwords using advanced algorithms.
password-generator.errorNoOption: Please select at least one character type.
password-generator.securityWarning: Your passwords are generated locally and securely in your browser (Web Crypto API). They are never sent or saved to any server.

pdf-merger.name: PDF Merger
pdf-merger.description: Merge multiple PDF files into a single document. Reorder pages and process with 100% privacy directly in your browser.
pdf-merger.errorMinFiles: You must select at least 2 PDF files to merge.
pdf-merger.errorInvalidFile: Please upload only valid PDF files.
pdf-merger.securityWarning: All operations are performed entirely in your browser (client-side). Your privacy is guaranteed; no files are uploaded or saved to the cloud.

qr-code-generator.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code-generator.description: Enter text or URL to instantly generate a high-quality QR code. Download as PNG or SVG.
qr-code-generator.inputPlaceholder: Enter https://auraconvert.pro or any plain text...
qr-code-generator.securityWarning: No data you enter is sent to a server. All QR code generation happens securely and offline directly in your browser.

text-case-converter.name: Text Case Converter
text-case-converter.description: Convert your text to various letter cases and formats (CamelCase, UPPERCASE, etc.) with a single click.
text-case-converter.inputPlaceholder: Type or paste your text here...
text-case-converter.securityWarning: All conversions are performed entirely in your browser (client-side). Your text is never sent to a server.

base64.name: Base64 Converter
base64.description: Securely encode your text to Base64 or decode Base64 data. Full support for Unicode and special characters.
base64.inputPlaceholderEncode: Enter text to encode to Base64...
base64.errorInvalidBase64: Error: Invalid Base64 format. Please check your input string.
base64.securityWarning: All conversions are performed entirely in your browser (client-side). Your text is never sent to a server.

url-encoder.name: URL Encoder
url-encoder.description: Securely encode your URLs or text, or decode URL-encoded data. Full support for special characters.
url-encoder.inputPlaceholderEncode: Enter text or URL to encode...
url-encoder.errorInvalidUrl: Error: Invalid URL-encoded format. Please check your input string.
url-encoder.securityWarning: All conversions are performed entirely in your browser (client-side). Your text is never sent to a server.

color-converter.name: Color Converter
color-converter.description: Instantly convert color codes between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats. Features live preview and color picker support.
color-converter.securityWarning: All conversions are performed in your browser (client-side).

timestamp-converter.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
timestamp-converter.description: Instantly convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates (and vice versa). Supports seconds, milliseconds, and local timezones.

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.description: Instantly decode JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Inspect Header, Payload, and Signature securely in your browser with 100% privacy.
jwt-decoder.securityWarning: This tool does not verify the JWT signature. Displaying the token does not mean it is valid or trusted. All processing is done entirely in your browser (client-side). Your token is never sent to a server or saved.
jwt-decoder.errorFormat: Invalid token format. JWT must consist of 3 parts separated by dots.
jwt-decoder.errorParse: Error decoding token. Invalid Base64URL or JSON format.

pdf-splitter.name: PDF Splitter
pdf-splitter.description: Select pages from your PDF files and export them as new PDF files. All processing happens 100% securely in your browser.
pdf-splitter.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a real PDF file.
pdf-splitter.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.
pdf-splitter.errorParse: Invalid page range. Please enter a valid range (e.g. 1-3, 5).
pdf-splitter.errorEmpty: Please select at least one page.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG \u2192 PDF
jpg-to-pdf.description: Merge your images (JPG/JPEG) into a single PDF file in seconds. 100% secure and free in your browser.
jpg-to-pdf.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a JPG/JPEG image.
jpg-to-pdf.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.
jpg-to-pdf.reorderInstructions: Drag images or use arrows to reorder them.

pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF \u2192 JPG
pdf-to-jpg.description: Convert your PDF files to high-quality JPG images. Select the pages you want and download securely.
pdf-to-jpg.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a real PDF file.
pdf-to-jpg.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.
pdf-to-jpg.errorEmpty: Please select at least one page.

pdf-rotator.name: PDF Rotator
pdf-rotator.description: Rotate pages within a PDF by 90°, 180°, or 270°. Free, secure, and runs entirely in your browser.
pdf-rotator.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a real PDF file.
pdf-rotator.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.

image-cropper.name: Image Cropper
image-cropper.description: Crop your images to any size and aspect ratio securely in your browser.
image-cropper.uploadFormats: JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported.
image-cropper.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a supported image.
image-cropper.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.

image-merger.name: Image Merger
image-merger.description: Merge multiple images horizontally, vertically, or in a grid into a single image.
image-merger.uploadFormats: JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported.
image-merger.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, all processing is done entirely in your browser.

exif-remover.name: EXIF Remover
exif-remover.description: Remove hidden EXIF metadata (GPS, camera model, date, etc.) from your images with one click.
exif-remover.uploadFormats: JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported.
exif-remover.securityNotice: Privacy notice: Your files are never uploaded to a server, metadata cleaning is done in your browser.
exif-remover.infoBox: Note: Metadata is wiped using the Canvas redraw method. The output image will not contain EXIF data.

calculator.name: Calculator
calculator.description: Safe, fast, and easy-to-use online calculator for your daily mathematical operations.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Find percentages, calculate percentage increase/decrease, add/subtract VAT, and calculate discounts.
percentage-calculator.calc2: What % is one number of another

age-calculator.name: Age Calculator
age-calculator.description: Instantly calculate your exact age (years, months, days), days until your next birthday, and day of birth.
age-calculator.futureError: Date of birth cannot be in the future!

unit-converter.name: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Instantly convert units of length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and time.

date-difference.name: Date Difference Calculator
date-difference.description: Calculate the total days, workdays, and exact years/months/days between two dates.
date-difference.swapped: Start date was after end date. Dates were automatically sorted.

stopwatch.name: Stopwatch & Timer
stopwatch.description: Record lap times with a precise stopwatch or set a custom timer with an alarm.

pdf-text-extractor.name: PDF Text Extractor
pdf-text-extractor.description: Extract text from your PDF files entirely in your browser, safely and instantly.
pdf-text-extractor.invalidFile: Invalid file. Please upload a valid PDF.
pdf-text-extractor.emptyWarning: No text found on this page. The document might be a scanned image.

image-rotator.name: Image Rotator
image-rotator.description: Rotate or flip your images in any direction. Download losslessly.
image-rotator.dragDrop: or drag and drop (JPG, PNG, WebP)

text-cleaner.name: Text Cleaner
text-cleaner.description: Clean up extra spaces, empty lines, and tabs. Format your text instantly.
